entry.author: Eastern Institute Of Technology
entry.summary:
From classroom learning to coastal living, experience what makes Tairāwhiti unique.

In this kōrero, Tracey Tangihaere, Executive Director of EIT’s Tairāwhiti Campus, takes us to beautiful Waikanae Beach, just minutes from where students learn, study, and connect.

Tracey shares one of the best parts about studying in Tairāwhiti: the ability to step out between classes, head to the beach for lunch, bring your surfboard and your togs, and enjoy everything this stunning region has to offer. It’s a place where education and lifestyle blend seamlessly, creating a study experience that’s relaxed, supportive, and uniquely Gisborne.

If you’re dreaming of learning in a close knit community with sunshine, surf, and a campus right on the doorstep of the ocean, EIT Tairāwhiti might just be the perfect place to begin your journey.
